items.t: GoPro: A Brand That Ran Out of Runway
items.sum: Investing.com -- GoPro’s stock has fallen 46.3% over one year as the company faces shrinking revenue, collapsing margins, a strained balance sheet, and uncertainty around a pending acquisition.

items.t: S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Rise Premarket — CRWV, GPRO, SPCX, NVDA, NLST Stocks In Focus
items.sum: Oil prices recovered from two-month lows, with both Brent crude futures and WTI futures rising as attacks on shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz kept supply concerns alive.
GoPro delayed its Q3 results and said it's seeking waivers from lenders, failing to secure which could jeopardize its merger with Starman Optical.

items.t: GoPro Says Q3 2026 Financial Statements To Reflect Substantial Doubt About Going Concern For Next 12 Months

GoPro Says Co. Unable To File Q3 Form 10-Q For Quarter Ended Sept 30, 2026 On Time; Requires Additional Time To Complete Q3 2026 Financial Close Procedures; Actively Seeking Waivers From Lenders Due To Noncompliance With Financing Covenants
GoPro Named Official POV Camera Partner of the Freeride World Tour, the World's Biggest Freeride Ski and Snowboard Competition, Through 2028
items.sum: Today, GoPro, Inc. (NASDAQ: GPRO) announced its continuation as the official POV camera partner of the Freeride World Tour by Peak Performance through the 2028 season, continuing a partnership that began in 2013. GoPro is also supporting "Freeride: No Second Run," a new docuseries from FWT Studios following the 2026 Freeride World Tour season. Watch the first two episodes now on the Freeride World
